title: Apply liquid glass material across Hopper interfaces
description: Audit existing desktop and native iOS surfaces, implement a shared adaptive glass material with theme tint preferences and accessibility fallbacks, preserve existing layouts and source media, verify UI and targeted builds.
notes: Complete: desktop and native shared material, system/light/dark palettes, adaptive contrast density, Chromium rim lens, separate tint settings, accessibility fallbacks and companion docs. Four material tests and Chromium regression/visual checks passed, including suspended-animation-frame startup. All 11 Rust tests, Clippy, macOS bundle and native iOS simulator build passed. Interactive native validation is tracked in hopper-tqd; no physical iPhone, Linux, Windows or actual Firefox runtime check claimed.
close_reason: Implemented and documented shared desktop/native material, theme tint preferences, optional Chromium rim lens and accessibility fallbacks. Material/browser regressions, 11 Rust tests, Clippy, macOS bundle and iOS simulator build passed. Native interactive walkthrough remains separately tracked as hopper-tqd.

title: Paired desktop and iOS media library
description: Build standalone Hopper for macOS/Linux/Windows desktops and iOS. Every desktop can import and play media; paired devices browse a merged library, stream over Iroh, cache media, persist queues and sync playback progress. Preserve the product roadmap: podcast feeds and reversible AI ad edits, Podcasting 2.0 metadata, M4B chapters, folders, semantic transcript search.

title: Core: paired Iroh nodes, media imports, merged library and progress
description: Implement shared Rust node with Iroh one-time pairing, SQLite state, content-addressed media, byte-range streaming, verified offline copies, per-device queue and Lamport progress sync. Test actual two-node transfers and rejected unauthorized peers.
close_reason: Shared Rust core implemented; unit tests and real two-way Iroh pairing/catalogue/range-stream/progress/cache/revocation integration pass.

title: Publish cleaned feeds and extend Podcasting 2.0 metadata support
description: Serve private cleaned RSS with original/edited enclosures, chapter artwork and transcript resources; implement remaining Podcasting 2.0 extensions and native chapter-art display. Current implementation stores/remaps chapters, VTT/SRT and soundbites but is not full namespace compliance.

title: Finish native iOS podcast UI walkthrough
description: Updated iOS build is installed and launches in iPhone 17 Pro simulator. Library/queue/tab bar visually confirmed. Device Hub coordinate taps fail with noWindowsAvailable while AX button actions work; Podcasts tab is not individually exposed to AX. Need unlocked Mac and manual Podcasts-tab selection (or restored coordinate control) to verify subscription, cut settings, remote job and cleaned playback. Mac locked again during October 30 follow-up. Synthetic feed /tmp/hopper-podcast-preview.py uses port 56564; already-paired preview library /tmp/hopper-preview-20261030 has local fake-LLM config. Test services stopped. No live LLM or physical-device validation claimed.

title: Import Apple/Castamatic podcasts and route additions to a Home desktop
description: Accept Apple Podcasts share links and Castamatic OPML; select a preferred Home desktop, queue additions while offline, forward files and podcast imports to Home, and add native iOS share intake. Spotify deliberately deferred.
close_reason: Implemented Apple/RSS/OPML intake, per-device Home selection, durable receipt-based deliveries, verified managed file forwarding, desktop/native controls, and iOS share inbox/extension. Eleven Rust tests, targeted delivery retest, Clippy, JavaScript syntax, macOS bundle and native simulator builds passed. Physical sharing and App Group provisioning tracked in hopper-lky.13; Spotify deferred in hopper-lky.14.

title: Validate Apple/Castamatic sharing and Home transfers on physical iPhone
description: Enable group.app.hopper.player for app and extension under the user development team; exercise Apple Podcasts show/episode share and a real Castamatic OPML export, share while main app terminated, choose Home after intake, invalid-share recovery, phone suspension/reopen during delivery, desktop offline/reconnect and WAN handoff. Simulator compilation and local three-node fixtures are not physical-device validation.
notes: November 12: Physical iPhone development profiles for Hopper and HopperShare were created, but grant an empty App Group list. Automatic registration did not resolve this. Pairing/playback installed with a temporary signing override. Enable group.app.hopper.player for both profiles and verify the full share extension.

title: Spotify podcast import (deferred)
description: Backburner at user request: prioritize Apple Podcasts and Castamatic. Future investigation may resolve public podcast links to publisher feeds; do not assume access to Spotify-exclusive or protected media.

title: Pair iPhone by QR and stream designated desktop folders
description: Render local one-use pairing codes, scan on iOS, persist and manage shared folder references on desktop, and exercise real iPhone install and playback.
close_reason: Desktop folder sharing, QR scanning, multiple peers and reconciliation implemented. On physical iPhone the user confirmed the sample played, and its completed 17.14-second checkpoint synced to the hosting Mac.

title: Desktop: cross-platform app with library, pairing, queue and playback
description: Tauri macOS/Linux/Windows client: shared library, folder filters, import/drop, pairing, download, progress and persistent queue. Validate macOS build and real UI; add CI for other OS builds without claiming they ran.
close_reason: Desktop library/import/pairing/queue/player implemented; macOS bundle built and launched, browser playback tested across WAV/MP3/M4B. Linux/Windows runtime release gate tracked separately in hopper-lky.6.

title: iOS: native library, pairing, downloads and background player
description: SwiftUI iOS client with Rust static core, pairing/library/downloads and native background AVQueuePlayer. Compile simulator/device where tools permit. Hardware lock-screen/network-change tests must remain explicitly pending until run.
close_reason: Native SwiftUI app and embedded Rust core build and launch in simulator; pairing, remote streaming, automatic queue advancement and relaunch restoration observed. Physical-phone validation remains hopper-lky.5.

title: Podcast ingestion, reversible ad processing, Podcasting 2.0 and semantic search
Validate physical iPhone background playback and network handoff
description: Run the device matrix in docs/validation.md: 30 minutes locked, at least three queue transitions, headset/lock-screen controls, interruptions, cellular handoff, offline copies, and relaunch. Native implementation and simulator checks do not complete this gate.

title: Validate and package Linux and Windows desktop builds
description: Run the supplied CI/build workflow on actual Linux and Windows hosts, validate imports/pairing/audio/video codecs and media controls, then produce installers. Source targets all three desktop OSes; only macOS has been built and launched locally.
notes: Desktop packaging must include or clearly provision FFmpeg/FFprobe and Python for the optional external MCP bridge. CI installs both; actual Linux/Windows validation remains outstanding.

title: Add watched folders and selective automatic replication
description: Retain folder metadata, watch changes, define rename/delete conflict policy, and replicate selected folders with resumable transfers and storage limits. Current implementation supports explicit import and verified keep-local only.

title: Podcast subscriptions, cut settings and pluggable audio-agent harness
description: Implement RSS subscriptions, per-show cut preferences, desktop processing through audio LLM or external agents, timestamp remapping, and desktop/iOS controls.
close_reason: Implemented RSS subscriptions and native/desktop cut controls, builtin audio LLM harness, Hermes/custom command and MCP inbox, durable jobs, immutable originals and shared metadata timeline. Eight Rust tests, Clippy, JavaScript checks, macOS bundle and iOS builds pass. Synthetic desktop UI walkthrough passed; real inference/vendor/device checks tracked separately.

title: Evaluate real audio models and live Hermes/Dot/Muse integration
description: Use configured audio credentials to evaluate ad boundary precision on representative podcasts and DnD episodes. Verify Hermes audio tools and actual MCP-client support/setup in Dot and Muse; fixture tests do not establish vendor integration or detection accuracy.
notes: Implemented builtin audio Chat Completions, Hermes chat --quiet -q adapter, custom argv and stdio MCP inbox. Contracts pass synthetic tests; actual model accuracy and third-party client support remain unverified. Setup: docs/agents.md.

title: Validate glass surfaces on native macOS and physical iPhone
description: Walk through glass library/player/podcasts/dialogs and both tint controls in the rebuilt macOS WebKit app and on an actual iPhone. Verify system light/dark appearance, Increase Contrast/Reduce Transparency, playback mini-player over scrolling content and performance/battery. Chromium screenshots and simulator compilation pass; native UI automation timed out in the November 4 design session, so interactive native checks remain unclaimed. Include background-window startup and older WebKit fallback.
